## What's Changed

- Repairs automatic Tube TV guide generation when an existing local-library index does not contain video durations.
- Stores movie and episode durations in future library scans and backfills older indexes without requiring media files to change.
- Keeps the last valid guide when a refresh temporarily cannot see the media library.
- Retries an empty guide on the five-minute planner interval instead of rebuilding it for every player request.
- Makes the Tater Tube Player home endpoint use the last cached guide immediately instead of waiting for a guide rebuild.
- Restarts recovery from the current time when the saved guide is empty, avoiding an unnecessarily large catch-up schedule.
- Keeps all existing Tater Tube player, music, and streaming endpoints compatible.

## Upgrade

Use your container manager's **Update/Recreate** action to pull
`ghcr.io/tatertotterson/tater-tube-server:latest` and recreate the existing container with its current settings. A plain container restart does not switch an existing container to the newly pulled image.

After restart, the background planner repairs the guide automatically. The first repair can take a little time while older indexed video durations are read, but Tater Tube Player home no longer waits for that work.
